reasoning_content:
Let's start by exploring the environment and checking what state the installation is in.

Main points to verify:
1. Whether the repository exists at /workspace
2. Whether local.json exists in /workspace/src/Bovis.Web
3. Whether the databases bohris.db and config.db exist
4. Whether the server is running (or can be started)
5. Whether http://localhost:5195/ serves the Blazor UI
6. Whether the app functions (the server subcommand, check subcommand)

First, let's check the current state.

action.command: echo "=== PWD ==="; pwd; echo "=== /workspace top ==="; ls -la /workspace; echo "=== Bovis.Web dir ==="; ls -la /workspace/src/Bovis.Web | head -50; echo "=== processes ==="; ps aux | grep -i -E "bovis|dotnet" | grep -v grep; echo "=== listening ports ==="; (ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null) | head -30

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"summary": "Inspect workspace layout and server state", "command": "echo \"=== PWD ===\"; pwd; echo \"=== /workspace top ===\"; ls -la /workspace; echo \"=== Bovis.Web dir ===\"; ls -la /workspace/src/Bovis.Web | head -50; echo \"=== processes ===\"; ps aux | grep -i -E \"bovis|dotnet\" | grep -v grep; echo \"=== listening ports ===\"; (ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null) | head -30", "security_risk": "LOW"}

summary: Inspect workspace layout and server state
